admission_policy: content+128; completion cap not charged at admission (groq-admission-probe-v1)

messages.content: Extract the query keywords and concepts needed to identify relevant graph entities. Use only concepts explicitly expressed in the query. Do not answer the query or add facts. Return strict JSON with exactly one key, keywords, containing a list of strings.

Which papers satisfy these requirements: the abstract explicitly includes at least one of “we derive an exact expression” or “we derive analytical expressions” (case-insensitive); and at least one author is affiliated with University of Insubria; and the recorded paper rank is at most 20071, and the recorded normalized venue namespace is journal?
